postconditions.expression: all(q_i <= n for q_i in q) and all(q_i <= q_i_plus_1 for q_i, q_i_plus_1 in zip(q, q[1:]))
postconditions.description: Each element in q is a number from 1 to n, and q is non-decreasing.

postconditions.expression: all(q_i == q_j for i, j in zip(range(n), range(n)))
postconditions.description: If all elements in q are the same, then the lexicographically minimal and maximal permutations are the same.

postconditions.expression: any(q_i != q_j for i, j in combinations(range(n), 2))
postconditions.description: If there are different elements in q, then the lexicographically minimal and maximal permutations are different.

postconditions.expression: all(q_i <= q_j for i, j in combinations(range(n), 2))
postconditions.description: The lexicographically minimal permutation is non-decreasing.

postconditions.expression: all(q_i >= q_j for i, j in combinations(range(n), 2))
postconditions.description: The lexicographically maximal permutation is non-increasing.
